## [0.1.0] — 2026-08-15

The first powered circuit. ⚡ (Hand-written; everything after this is
generated from commits.)

### Added
- The kernel: register (catalog · bind · graph) over HTTP+JSON and gRPC,
  one selection logic behind both transports.
- Conformance runner (`redstone verify`): executable packs per capability
  level, verdicts enforced at bind time — a provider that can't honor its
  claim is unbindable, with the reason in writing.
- The stack file format (`docs/stack-spec.yaml`, locked): `gives`/`uses`,
  opaque `with` edge config, recursive verified `wire` bindings,
  declaration-driven binds, `--strict` mode.
- Daemon-free CLI: `validate` (typos are errors, not silence), `ls`, `add`
  (validation-gated, atomic rollback), `rm` (referential integrity).
- Self-compacting graph (`graph.jsonl` + audit archive), registry lint at
  boot, verdict-staleness warning, HTTP server timeouts.
- 18-test build gate (network-free fixtures) + `smoke.sh` deployment battery.
- The vibe (humans get sparks, machines get JSON) and the banner.

### Changed
- Wire namespace `mystack.core.v1` → `redstone.core.v1` — one deliberate
  break, taken before any external consumer existed. Frozen since.
